Chapter 1016: Chapter 25: Catastrophe (Subscribe)

“Every time a universe undergoes a great annihilation, it attracts countless robbers.”

Another Robber Clan ultimate spoke.

No matter where you are, plundering is one of the fastest ways to acquire resources and wealth.

In the Chaos Void, the weak are prey to the strong. Most regions lack any semblance of order, so naturally, robbers flourish.

To nearly all robbers, universes birthed by the Chaos Void are akin to a delicacy. They have no particular attachment to the universe itself, but their interest lies in the Twelve-Layer powerhouses who survive the great annihilation.

These Twelve-Layer powerhouses, who have lingered within their cosmic cradle, are certainly weaker in battle compared to their counterparts in the Chaos Void, who have endured countless brutal wars.

After a great annihilation, the Twelve-Layer powerhouses who survive and enter the Chaos Void are bound to carry vast amounts of cosmic resources and treasures.

Weak in combat yet carrying so many treasures?

They naturally become the “golden prize” in the eyes of every robber.

“Indeed.”

The Robber Clan ultimate who had spoken first nodded in agreement.

Among the Chaos Void robbers, there are powerful figures, even those who have reached the Dominator Realm.

After all, when a universe undergoes great annihilation, any Twelve-Layer ultimate who endures the calamity will carry treasures and weapons worth at least ten thousand Chaos Stones.

With the strength of a Dominator Realm powerhouse, suppressing a Path Splitting Realm figure emerging from a destroyed universe would be effortless.

Casually seizing ten thousand, or even tens of thousands of Chaos Stones? A Dominator Realm expert wouldn’t pass up such an opportunity.

“Under normal circumstances, predicting the timing of a universe’s great annihilation is nearly impossible. From the outside, there’s no indication, so even if robbers wish to plunder, they can’t pinpoint the exact time of destruction. They can’t simply linger nearby forever, can they?”

The second Robber Clan ultimate remarked: “But according to the intelligence gathered by the strongest figures of the Galaxy, our universe is set to enter its great annihilation prematurely due to the aftermath of a battle between two Chaos Great Saints.”

“With the power of the Chaos Great Saints, the range of influence from their clash should extend far beyond our universe.”

“Thus, we hypothesize that a massive swarm of robbers will follow these two Great Saints, specifically targeting universes affected by their battle that are prematurely pushed into great annihilation.”

The two Robber Clan ultimates had thought everything through strategically.

In truth, their own survival wouldn’t be greatly impacted by the premature annihilation of the universe since they wouldn’t venture out. The Robber Clan’s population was already sparse, and their ancestral dwelling could comfortably accommodate everyone.

But the strongest figures of the Galaxy?

When the strongest figures of the Galaxy relocate all citizens of human civilization, the great annihilation calamity they face would undoubtedly be unimaginably terrifying.

Under such circumstances, they might sustain injuries. Upon entering the Chaos Void, encountering ambushes by robbers would likely prove troublesome.

The two Robber Clan ultimates didn’t believe that the strongest figures of the Galaxy would fall as a result—what a joke! A Great Saint reincarnated wouldn’t be defeated, no matter how severe their injuries, even by a swarm of Dominator Realm powerhouses.

Their advice was purely a reminder—for Lin Yuan to remain vigilant.

“Thank you for your warning.”

Lin Yuan’s tone was calm.

The two Robber Clan ultimates had made valid points. Even an actual Chaos Realm Venerable facing the universe’s final retaliatory surge could not guarantee escaping unscathed.

But Lin Yuan?

These two Robber Clan ultimates were still unaware of the extent of Lin Yuan’s abilities: his Physical Body Divine Ability of “rebirth from a single drop of blood,” along with the “Xuanhuang Physique” and “Elemental Physique.”

No matter how severe the injuries, Lin Yuan’s recovery was a matter of moments.

Unless he was obliterated instantly and entirely, death was almost impossible for him.

…

Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

Lin Yuan smoothly entered the fragment world of “Star Tears.”

“Not bad, not bad.”

Lin Yuan appeared quite satisfied.

This fragment world, while only one-thousandth the size of the Main Universe, could completely accommodate all citizens of the human civilization.

It’s important to note that within the Cosmic Starry Skies of the Main Universe, most of the regions are inhospitable Star Domains. Citizens primarily reside on Life Planets.

Yet for the Star Tears fragment world, there are no inhospitable areas, with its livable and habitable zones encompassing nearly the entire world. Not only could it house the entire human civilization, but it could effortlessly accommodate all species and life forms within the Main Universe as well.

In comparison to sheer living space, this fragment world wasn’t much smaller than the Main Universe.

“The aura of Star Tears…”

Lin Yuan gazed down at the Star Tears fragment world, sensing a gentle energy suffusing the land. It was highly conducive to the nurturing and growth of life.

The Dominator Wanqu dared to price this fragment world at 1.2 million Chaos Stones largely due to the natural properties of Star Tear minerals.

“The propagation and nurturing of life are best carried out within the Chaos Void and individual universes. Only there can life achieve the greatest potential, endowed with nearly infinite possibilities.”

Lin Yuan pondered silently.

In terms of nurturing life, no internal cosmos—whether Lin Yuan’s or a Chaos Venerable’s—could compare to the cosmic void and the universes birthed within it.

In terms of level alone, Lin Yuan’s internal cosmos, or that of any Chaos Venerable, was not weaker than universes born of the Chaos Void.

But when it came to life-nurturing capacity, they fell far short.

Even in the cosmos of a Chaos Great Saint, the life it nurtured was perpetually locked at the Eleventh Layer, with those advancing to the Twelfth Layer being extraordinarily rare, and Dominator Realm internal cosmos lifeforms having never appeared at all.

“According to the legacy of the “Infinite Void,” the Chaos Void contains an intrinsic vitality force. It is precisely this vitality that grants the life it nurtures unparalleled potential, a quality absent in internal cosmoses.”
